title: Model 2 GOES SST-pattern motion versus drifters: not supported
scope: Retrospective co-motion check of GOES sea-surface-temperature pattern shifts against archived drifter six-hour displacements, under a frozen protocol.
summary: Only 8 of 157 eligible primary (drogued, April to September) windows passed the acceptance filters (5.1%), covering 4 drifter clusters, too few for an interval. Vector RMSE was 0.3310 m/s versus 0.2925 m/s for a zero-vector diagnostic, with a median angular separation of 81.1 degrees. The result does not justify building a GOES-motion module. A secondary undrogued stratum (118 windows, 28 drifters) had RMSE 0.2309 versus 0.2503 m/s (clustered 95% interval 0.2008 to 0.2654) and does not rescue the primary result.

limitations: The source report is an untracked working-tree file; it is identified by SHA-256 only and has no source commit.
Historically exposed drifter development data, not independent confirmation.
The tile uses the observed endpoint midpoint in hindsight; this is neither forecast skill nor serving qualification.
Two acceptance filters (correlation and search boundary) were new preregistered rules; cloud support dominates attrition.
The result does not show that SST-pattern co-motion is false in general.
